blocks.content: I'm Abidit, a Software Engineer at Programiz Pro, and I'll be guiding you through this course.
Here, you'll build a fully playable Brick Breaker game from scratch. You'll create the paddle, move the ball, break bricks, and bring everything together into a complete experience.
I still remember the first time I built something like this. It wasn't anything fancy, but seeing everything move and respond together felt completely different from anything I had built before.
That's the moment this course is designed to give you.
Next, let's take a look at what you'll build. Click on Next Lesson to continue.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
